scenes.base_scene_prompt: Horus and Embry sit at a patio table under a simple umbrella in a surreal void-world tea setting. Use the character reference sheets for identity continuity, the void tea terrace and void world sheets for place continuity, and keep the Tyranid-like creatures as distant background motion only. The scene is quiet, intimate, and source-grounded; no new lore, no subtitles, no readable text.

dialogue_contract.note: Provider runners must fill exact_dialogue from the accepted timed script before calling paid media APIs.
